# Riffpad

> Watch, approve, and steer AI coding agents from your phone.

## Landing

- [Riffpad](https://riffpad.ai/): Watch, approve, and steer AI coding agents from your phone.

## Docs

- [Quickstart](https://riffpad.ai/docs/guide/quickstart): Install the CLI, sign in, pair, and start your first hosted session
- [Remote control](https://riffpad.ai/docs/guide/remote): Watch, approve, and steer coding agent sessions from your phone
- [CLI](https://riffpad.ai/docs/reference/cli): Full riffpad command reference
- [Architecture](https://riffpad.ai/docs/reference/architecture): How the daemon, relay, and clients interact
- [Security model](https://riffpad.ai/docs/reference/security): End-to-end encryption and zero-knowledge relay
- [FAQ](https://riffpad.ai/docs/faq): Frequently asked questions

## Project

- [GitHub](https://github.com/riffpad/riffpad): Source code, issues, releases, and install scripts
